title: Viva Insights: leaders can publish Power BI reports
notes: claim 86: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The rollout, default and policy instructions are supported. The licensing gap must be narrowed to additional requirements for this feature, because Microsoft already publishes requirements for using Viva Insights; the impact rationale also incorrectly says analysts gain publishing, which they already have.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licence requirement for leader publishing.
claims.quote: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.
claims.fix: Narrow the gap everywhere to 'Microsoft has not published an additional licence requirement specifically for leader publishing.' In Cost and licensing add: 'Existing platform requirements apply: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/environment-requirements. Keep the feature-specific licensing model unknown rather than implying the platform has no published requirements.
